title: Introduce SDK Error Signal Layer with Recovery Recipes and Language Examples
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Create a lightweight 'Error Signal Layer' in each SDK (Python, TypeScript, Go) that normalizes low-level runtime errors into a small set of well-documented signals and pairs each signal with concise, actionable recovery recipes. This ticket scopes design and initial implementation of the layer plus canonical examples for streaming resume, idempotent retries, and guidance for transient vs terminal states.

Scope:
- Define canonical signals (e.g., TransientNetworkError, RateLimit, CapacityExhausted, ModelMismatch, StreamCheckpointLost, PayloadValidationError).
- Provide an SDK surface that exposes: error.code, error.hints (list), error.retry_after (ms), error.stream_resume_token (opaque string when applicable).
- Implement language idiomatic wrappers that map runtime errors into these signals for Python/TS/Go.
- Write recovery recipes for common scenarios (automatic retry with backoff, single-shot user prompt re-try, stream resume using resume token, fallback to cheaper model variant).
- Add telemetry hooks so each emitted signal includes stable error_id and optional fingerprint to drive dashboarding.

Out of scope for this ticket:
- UI console work (dashboard ingestion) beyond placeholder telemetry events.
- Enterprise RBAC or audit log changes.

Acceptance criteria:
1) RFC describing signal set and surface approved by API/SDK leads.
2) Python + TS + Go SDKs each contain a thin adapter that maps runner/runtime failures to the error signals and exposes the recovery hints in the public exception type.
3) At least three documented examples per language: (a) idempotent retry for idempotent endpoints, (b) streaming resume when resume token present, (c) graceful fallback to cached/cheaper model on high latency.
4) Unit tests that assert mapping correctness and telemetry emission.
5) Example PRs linked and reviewed by SDK reviewers.

Design notes:
- We intentionally keep the public schema compact: up to 4 canonical fields on the exception object. This reduces cross-language translation surface and avoids leaking runtime internals.
- For streaming, resume tokens are opaque strings; SDKs should attempt resume automatically for one attempt, then surface a RecoverableStreamError with the token for manual retries.
- We prioritize clear human-facing hints in error.hints: short sentences like 'retry after exponential backoff', 'use cached response if available', 'reduce max_tokens to stay under GPU memory'.
